objects.name: Detection technique coverage: kubernetes-daemonset-deployed
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of a DaemonSet in a Kubernetes cluster. This behavior is identified by monitoring Kubernetes Audit logs for the creation event of a DaemonSet. DaemonSets ensure a specific pod runs on every node, making them a potential vector for persistent access. This activity is significant for a SOC as it could indicate an attempt to maintain persistent access to the Kubernetes infrastructure.
